deathSays.line: Movement — a waddling opossum, playing dead (badly).
👁 You know this one's trick: it plays dead. Don't fall for it — or do, and be ready when it wakes.

🔥 The fire settles. the person in their 50s has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "A crow that watches too long and blinks too little — I put it down today." "Its shadow detaches from the branch-shadow and slides across the ground toward you — a straight black lane, growing. The bird hasn't moved. The shadow has." "It climbs, laughing in a dead voice — out of spear reach, watching." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. the man in his 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm says quietly "Did it look at you? Before?" Joyce says quietly "The fire feels smaller now."
Movement — a crow watching you from a dead branch, head cocked.
📻 "Why do the small humans keep putting organic matter in their FACE-HOLES? We built you a fusion pellet! ...You BURIED it. WHY did you bury the pellet?!"
